title: ServerScriptService
summary: The canonical home for server Scripts: never replicates to clients, and Scripts here run automatically on the server at startup.

details.heading: Behavior
details.body: Scripts parented anywhere inside ServerScriptService run on the server when it starts. Contents never reach clients — code included. LocalScripts placed here do NOT run.

explanation.whatItIs: The server's code vault. Drop a Script in, it runs on the server, and players never even know it exists.
explanation.whyItExists: Keeping server logic in one invisible-to-clients place protects it and organizes your project: all authoritative systems live here.
whenToUse: Every plain Script by default — round managers, data saving, economy
Server ModuleScripts can live here too (or in ServerStorage)
Organizing with folders: Game/, Data/, Remotes-handlers/
whenNotToUse: For LocalScripts — they don't run here
For anything clients must require — use ReplicatedStorage
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
ServerScriptService
 ├─ Main (Script)          → runs on server startup
 ├─ Rounds/ (Scripts+Modules)
 └─ DataSaving/ (Scripts)
Clients: (cannot see any of this)
```
tips: One 'Main' Script that requires your server modules keeps startup explicit
RemoteEvent handlers belong here — connected before clients can fire
commonMistakes: Putting a LocalScript here and debugging why nothing happens
Leaving important server Scripts in workspace where they can be touched/destroyed by other code

examples.title: Clean server bootstrap
examples.code:
-- ServerScriptService/Main (Script)
local RoundManager = require(script.Parent.Modules.RoundManager)
local DataManager = require(script.Parent.Modules.DataManager)
local RemoteHandlers = require(script.Parent.Modules.RemoteHandlers)

DataManager.init()
RemoteHandlers.init()
RoundManager.start()

print("Server systems online")
